about: Output with COLOR_RGB, on the rgb8 profile (types/0x0020-output.md §5.8; zadania/devices/DEVICE-03.md K1–K5): the colour is the components at full brightness, independent of Level — commands of the level leave it alone and SetColor leaves Level alone; SetColor(0,0,0,0) is INVALID_VALUE; one transition for both, linear on each component, a new command interrupting either; SetColor when dark changes the colour at once and lights nothing; the colour is 0–254 like every u8 (0xFF is 'absent'), persistent, stored 5 s after the last change, and PowerOnBehaviour ON lights at LastLevel in it. The library hands over intent: White stays White here — adding it to R, G and B on a board without a white LED is the device's.

steps.note: ON: LastLevel in the stored colour, red
SetColor(0, 0, 254, 0, 0): at once; only the components that changed are reported
black is not a colour: dark is Level's
SetColor without its transition: a wrong length
Red is read-only — SetColor is the way
0xFF is u8's 'absent', not a full channel — the components end at 254 (types/0x0020-output.md §3)
half-way, each component on its own; Level untouched
the end: the colour reached and Transitioning in one round
SetColor(0, 254, 0, 0, 0) a quarter of the way: interrupts the level at 625, the colour at once; the round is inside ReportMinGap
Off fades the level, the colour stays
SetColor(0, 0, 254, 0, 400) when dark: at once, no transition, nothing lit
White is intent: reported and handed over as it was given
On: LastLevel 625 in the new colour
5 s from the last change of the colour or LastLevel (2200) — not yet
stored together: the colour, and the LastLevel Off gave it
